name: pr-code-review
description: Multi-model AI code review. An orchestrator skill dispatches non-mutating code-reviewer sub-agents that report coverage-first findings with confidence scores; the orchestrator filters and synthesizes them into a findings report plus machine-readable JSON. Reviewers investigate freely and may build/run/test the code to verify findings, but the review is non-mutating: it produces findings only and does not edit code, post PR comments, create PRs, or file work items. Invoked manually only (not auto-invoked, to avoid review loops).
